ambiguities.text: Payloads 'MAY be queued' pending blob arrival — the specification does not define queuing behavior, timeout, or retry semantics.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that implementations may optionally queue blocks for a bounded time waiting for blobs, but the specification does not mandate any specific queuing mechanism. Blocks without available blobs are simply not accepted.

ambiguities.text: Blocks validated previously 'retain their status even if blobs are later pruned' — unclear whether this applies to reorganizations.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that once a block passes the data availability check and is added to the store, it remains valid even after blob pruning (after MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS). Reorgs would need separate handling.

implicit_assumptions.description: Blob data is available on the P2P network for at least MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs after block inclusion.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: New nodes syncing from scratch might be unable to validate historical blocks if blob data has been pruned before they can retrieve it.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot selectively withhold blob data from specific nodes while making it available to others within the availability window.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Targeted data withholding could cause honest nodes to disagree on block validity, potentially splitting the fork choice view.

implicit_assumptions.description: Extraneous or invalid blobs received from the network do not invalidate otherwise-valid blocks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could prevent block acceptance by injecting invalid blob sidecars that claim to match a valid block.
